# HDashboardShell

> A complete dashboard frame with desktop sidebar, native mobile navigation dialog, account controls, and content area.

[Start with the Hearth UI agent index](../../../llms.txt). This reference describes repository source; package.json version: 0.2.0. Match it to the source/release you are using.

## Identity

- Vue export: `HDashboardShell` from `@samishal1998/hearth-ui`.
- Custom element: `<hearth-dashboard-shell>`.
- Individual constructor: `HearthDashboardShellElement` from `@samishal1998/hearth-ui/elements`.
- Category: Layouts.
- [Implementation](https://github.com/samishal1998/hearth-ui/blob/main/src/components/HDashboardShell.vue).

## Choose and use it correctly

- Use as the authenticated workspace frame. It supplies desktop/sidebar and mobile-drawer presentation, not authentication or authorization.
- The desktop navigation slot can replace the default list, but the mobile drawer uses items. Keep items populated even when customizing desktop navigation.
- header-actions, sidebar-footer, brand, and footer support application composition. The default slot is the content region.

## Public API

brand, logo, workspace, workspaceDescription, active, pageTitle, username, userRole, footerNote: string · items: NavItem[]

A `?` marks optional source props. A prop with a default may be omitted even when the source type is required. Internal `formDisabled` and `control-sync` plumbing is excluded below; do not use it in application code.

```ts
type Props = {
    brand?: string;
    logo?: string;
    workspace?: string;
    workspaceDescription?: string;
    items: NavItem[];
    active?: string;
    pageTitle?: string;
    username?: string;
    userRole?: string;
    footerNote?: string;
};
```

### Defaults

```ts
{
    brand: "hearth",
    workspace: "My workspace",
    workspaceDescription: "Self-hosted & personal",
    items: () => [],
    pageTitle: "Overview",
    userRole: "Workspace owner",
    footerNote: "Hosted by you. Right where it belongs.",
  }
```

### Events

navigate(id), logout()

```ts
type Emits = {
    navigate: [
        id: string
    ];
    logout: [
    ];
};
```

Vue-emitted custom-element events expose arguments as `event.detail`, an array. Listen directly on the element. Native DOM events such as `click` keep their normal payloads.

### Slots

brand, navigation (desktop), header-actions, sidebar-footer, default, footer

Vue uses `<template #slotName>`; custom elements use `<div slot="slotName">`. Custom elements do not support Vue scoped slots.

### CSS parts

base, sidebar, header, content, footer, mobile-navigation

Use `hearth-dashboard-shell::part(part-name)` for an exposed part, or inherited `--h-*` tokens for system-level styling. Native Vue components use the shared stylesheet and `h-*` classes.

## Supporting types

```ts
export interface NavItem {
    id: string;
    label: string;
    icon?: string;
    href?: string;
    badge?: string | number;
    disabled?: boolean;
}
```

## Vue example

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from 'vue';
import { HDashboardShell, HPageHeader } from '@samishal1998/hearth-ui';
import '@samishal1998/hearth-ui/styles.css';
const active = ref('overview');
const items = [{ id: 'overview', label: 'Overview', icon: 'home' }, { id: 'apps', label: 'Applications', icon: 'apps' }];
function signOut() { /* Revoke the application session. */ }
</script>

<template>
  <HDashboardShell brand="homestead" :items="items" :active="active" page-title="Overview" username="Owner" @navigate="active = $event" @logout="signOut">
    <HPageHeader title="Your workspace." />
  </HDashboardShell>
</template>
```

## Web-component example

Provide a mount point (use a `form` instead of `div` when demonstrating field submission):

```html
<div id="example"></div>
```

The following is bundler-based ESM. For raw HTML, load `dist/themes.css` with a stylesheet link and import `registerElements` from `./dist/elements/index.js` instead. Set array/object properties before connection when they should become reset defaults.

```js
import { registerElements } from '@samishal1998/hearth-ui/elements';
import '@samishal1998/hearth-ui/themes.css';
registerElements();

const mount = document.querySelector('#example');
const element = document.createElement('hearth-dashboard-shell');
Object.assign(element, {
  "brand": "homestead",
  "active": "overview",
  "pageTitle": "Overview",
  "username": "Owner",
  "items": [
    {
      "id": "overview",
      "label": "Overview",
      "icon": "home"
    },
    {
      "id": "apps",
      "label": "Applications",
      "icon": "apps"
    }
  ]
});
element.innerHTML = "<hearth-page-header title=\"Your workspace.\"></hearth-page-header>"; // Static example markup only; never inject untrusted HTML.
element.addEventListener('navigate', event => { element.active = event.detail[0]; });
element.addEventListener('logout', () => { /* Revoke the application session. */ });
mount.append(element);
```
